rationale: Section 17C-5-2b(c) makes the affidavit a condition of the motion: the motion 'must be supported by the defendant's affidavit'.
The registry packetSet lists it as a required component with outputStrategy 'custom_pleading' and no officialFormId.
No West Virginia Judiciary form exists for it — the Court Forms index publishes five expungement forms, all § 61-11-25 or § 61-11-26 instruments.

It is drafted as a container of the participant's own averments only. The other thing subsection (c) requires the motion to be supported by — the Division of Motor Vehicles certification — is an agency document and is NOT drafted.

primaryStatutoryAuthority.description: When the defendant has satisfactorily completed the Motor Vehicle Alcohol Test and Lock Program and complied with its conditions, the defendant may move the court for an order dismissing the charges; the motion must be supported by the defendant's affidavit and by certification of the Division of Motor Vehicles that the programme was successfully completed; the prosecuting attorney has 30 days after service to advise the judge of objections, in the absence of which the court shall dismiss.

The predicate the submission rests on: the court, without entering a judgment of guilt, deferred further proceedings and placed the participant on probation conditioned on successful completion of the Motor Vehicle Alcohol Test and Lock Program under § 17C-5A-3a.

qaProhibitedTermsNote: Four groups, each for a distinct sourced reason. (1) 'petition' and 'petitioner': every West Virginia Judiciary expungement form catalogued in the committed state pack and named in the compiled profile is a petition or motion under § 61-11-25 or § 61-11-26 — a different statute with a different fee regime, a different service list, a once-per-lifetime limit under § 61-11-26(o), and an express § 61-11-26b bar on expunging DUI convictions. Section 17C-5-2b says the defendant may MOVE the court and the person may APPLY to the court, and the registry names the instruments a motion and an application. A document styling itself a petition would read as the § 61-11-26 packet the participant must not be sold. (2) 'seal', 'sealed', 'sealing': sealing of court records is the § 61-11-26 remedy — the profile records that on a granted § 61-11-26 order the court orders court records sealed and agency records expunged. Section 17C-5-2b(g) speaks only of expunging official records and says nothing about sealing. (3) 'destroy', 'destroyed', 'destruction', 'erase': the committed state pack's own never-say list forbids telling a participant that this destroys every record or that no one can ever see it again, and the profile records that legally authorised criminal-history checks and law-enforcement-type job applications can still reach expunged convictions. (4) 'pardon', 'vacate', 'vacatur', 'acquittal', 'acquitted', 'pretrial diversion', 'deferred adjudication': each names a different West Virginia route — § 5-1-16a pardon relief, § 61-14-9 trafficking vacatur, the § 61-11-25 acquittal/dismissal motion on SCA-C903, § 61-11-22 pretrial diversion (from which DUI is expressly excluded) and § 61-11-22a deferred adjudication. A § 17C-5-2b deferral is none of them, and using their vocabulary would misdescribe the relief and blur the routing boundary. Scope: these terms are prohibited in the RENDERED DOCUMENT TEXT of this component only. Several of them necessarily appear in participant-facing routing and disclosure copy, where they do necessary work — telling the participant that this is not the conviction-expungement route and that an expunged record is still reachable by legally authorised checks. (5) 'expunge', 'expunged', 'expunging', 'expungement' are additionally prohibited on this stage-one component. Subsection (c) produces dismissal and discharge without adjudication of guilt; expungement is a separate submission under subsection (g), available only after a further year has run from the expiration of probation and barred outright by any prior felony conviction. The registry models the two apart precisely because their contents, timing and legal effect all differ, and a stage-one document that asked for or promised expungement would collapse that separation.

counselFlags.statement: No West Virginia Judiciary form exists for either the § 17C-5-2b(c) motion to dismiss or the § 17C-5-2b(g) application to expunge. The Court Forms index was read at source on 2026-08-06 and publishes exactly five expungement forms — SCA-C900, SCA-C903, SCA-C906, SCA-C907 and SCA-C912 — none of which is a § 17C-5-2b filing; the committed state pack catalogues the same five and ties each to § 61-11-25 or § 61-11-26. On that basis the controlling review's build blocker is answered in the negative and every court document in this route is a custom pleading. Whether an unpublished local form is used in some courts was not tested.
counselFlags.mustConfirm: Whether any court uses an unpublished local form for a § 17C-5-2b filing.

counselFlags.statement: What LegalEase cannot complete: the Division of Motor Vehicles certification that the test and lock program was successfully completed. Section 17C-5-2b(c) requires the motion to dismiss to be supported by it, so the motion cannot go in without it, but it is an agency document the participant obtains by asking the Division of Motor Vehicles. No form number, no request letter and no template is recorded for it anywhere in the sources, so none is drafted and no agency_request_letter unit exists in this route. LegalEase does not obtain, receive or inspect it, and no drafted document characterises what it says.
counselFlags.mustConfirm: That no pipeline stage produces or files the motion to dismiss without the participant holding the Division of Motor Vehicles certification.

counselFlags.statement: The two stages must never be merged into one filing. The registry models them as separate units because the required contents, the timing and the legal effect all differ: the subsection (c) motion needs the defendant's affidavit and the Division of Motor Vehicles certification and produces dismissal and discharge without adjudication of guilt; the subsection (g) application cannot be made until a further year has run from the expiration of probation, is barred outright by any prior felony conviction, and produces expungement of the criminal record. Unit 1 must have produced a dismissal before unit 2 becomes available at all. The words expunge, expunged and expungement are prohibited in the unit-1 document text for exactly this reason.
counselFlags.mustConfirm: That the pipeline cannot emit the subsection (g) application at the same time as the subsection (c) motion, and that stageNeeded gates which components are produced.

counselFlags.statement: Subsection (f) makes four categories ineligible for dismissal and discharge under the section: any prosecution in which any violation of any other provision of article 17C-5 has been charged; any person holding a commercial driver's licence or operating commercial motor vehicles; any person previously having had a licence revoked for an offence with the same elements under a municipal ordinance of this state or any other state or a statute of the United States or any other state; and any person as to whom a court entered an order finding a refusal of the secondary chemical test under § 17C-5-7a. Subsection (e) allows only one discharge and dismissal under the section. Each is screened as a hard exclusion and each is a self-help stop condition; none is asserted as satisfied in any drafted document.
counselFlags.mustConfirm: That each subsection (f) bar and the one-discharge limit are screened before any document is produced.

AFFIDAVIT OF THE DEFENDANT IN SUPPORT OF MOTION TO DISMISS THE CHARGES PURSUANT TO W. VA. CODE § 17C-5-2b(c).

Averments only, and only of facts within the participant's own knowledge that the registry's generationRequirements collect: that the court deferred the proceedings and placed them on probation on a stated date; the probation term; that they successfully completed the Motor Vehicle Alcohol Test and Lock Program on a stated date; and that they complied with the conditions of probation. Each is the participant's own statement of fact. Nothing is averred about what the Division of Motor Vehicles certification says, because the participant obtains it and LegalEase never inspects it; nothing is averred about the prosecuting attorney or the court.
Cited once, for why the affidavit exists: § 17C-5-2b(c) requires the motion to be supported by the defendant's affidavit.

provenance.profileSilenceNote: The compiled WV profile contains no occurrence of '17C-5-2b', 'Test and Lock', '17C-5A-3a' or any DUI-deferral pathway. Its only occurrences of '17C-5-2' are the single repeated statement that DUI under 17C-5-2 is excluded from pretrial diversion under 61-11-22. This route therefore rests on the pinned registry entry; the profile and the committed state pack are used only for the West Virginia court-level, form-catalogue, intake-field and terminology facts they do record.
